dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Women aren't complicated but most of us have a hard time with reconciling the idealization of the woman we want to be with; with the reality that she cannot be everything we were hoping for.

@dogecoin_empire I'm close to telling my niece (who is like a daughter to me) that I have foxhole depression, I can't meet and get to know these awesome guys and then have her dump them a month later. Hurts too much to get close...
